reuse.why: Changes only the existing getWorstCaseAmount and getApproximateWorstCaseAmount helpers that getScheduledAmount already routes every ranged and approximate amount through, still using getApproxNumberThreshold.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; each rule is a one-line change in its single definition.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, where the worst-case helpers live.

scope.why: Two helper bodies, their tests and the release note only.

maintainability.why: Math.min and value minus threshold state the 'lowest allowed value' rule directly and are easy to own.
